action: Exact-release source inspection of rmcp-v3.1.4 MetaObject representation and serde/construction behavior.
finding: At exact release commit 4a738b9d..., MetaObject is a serde-transparent wrapper over JsonObject, derives Serialize and Deserialize, documents preservation of arbitrary extension keys, exposes Deref/DerefMut to the underlying map, and its implementation inserts arbitrary string keys with JSON values. This is source-level positive evidence that an arbitrary namespaced generation/fence key can be inserted into MetaObject and serialized/deserialized without defining a custom wire type.
scope_guard: This proves only the exact MetaObject source contract at the pinned release. It does not prove that every task/result type exposes MetaObject, that intermediaries preserve the chosen key, that the key is authenticated or authoritative, or that persistent create-or-get/restart redrive/external-effect idempotency is solved.
exact_continuation: Next invocation: bootstrap current manifest/lifecycle/root/open_source authority with exact same-path identities and SHA-only freshness; reconstruct role-local LATEST; then exact-fetch only modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056 task/result model definitions that carry task status/results, and determine whether the relevant task/result response surface actually exposes MetaObject so the now-proven arbitrary namespaced generation/fence key can travel on that wire path. Record exact support or blocker. Do not open authenticated-principal, persistent-store, redrive, or external-effect idempotency as a second leaf; persist one bounded checkpoint/readback and return recurring-open.
